profile.name: Samyak Moon
profile.tagline: I design and build scalable, secure fintech systems — payments, cards, and the distributed plumbing behind them.
profile.bio: Backend Software Engineer with 2.8+ years designing and building scalable, secure fintech systems in Java and Spring Boot. I work across microservices, distributed systems, and payment and card platforms, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and system design. I like problems where correctness, concurrency, and money all have to line up at scale.

services.title: Backend & Distributed Systems
services.description: Microservices and multi-tenant platforms in Java and Spring Boot — designed for concurrency, idempotency, and reliability at scale, with gRPC and event-driven messaging between services.

services.title: Payments & Security
services.description: Card and payment flows across Visa and RuPay — authorization, settlement, and reconciliation — with PCI-DSS-compliant crypto, HSM integration, JWT/RBAC auth, and OTP/2FA.

services.title: Cloud & DevOps
services.description: Shipping and operating services on AWS with Jenkins CI/CD, plus observability through the ELK stack and Grafana so systems stay debuggable and measurable in production.

services.title: AI-Powered Development
services.description: Using Cursor and LLM-powered workflows to move faster without giving up rigor — from scaffolding and refactors to review, while keeping architecture and correctness my call.

experience.summary: Owning payment, card, and authentication systems end-to-end on a fintech platform serving 10+ enterprise clients.
highlights: Designed and owned the Card Order Workflow end-to-end with a maker–checker approval pattern and Quartz-based async scheduling for Visa and RuPay card generation; optimised for parallel processing, cutting generation time for 10K+ cards by 85%.

Built SecureAuthPro, a multi-tenant authentication & authorization service on Spring Boot, Redis, and RSA-256 JWT; enforced strict tenant isolation, RBAC, and OTP-based login across 10+ enterprise clients to meet regulatory security standards.

Designed the Wallet-to-Account (W2A) transfer API with idempotency guarantees, concurrency control, and retries, plus a Quartz-based async refund job for failed transactions — ensuring data consistency and financial reconciliation at scale.

Enhanced authorization & settlement flows for Visa and RuPay across e-commerce, POS, and ATM channels, reducing latency and adding an external authentication mechanism for clients to approve/reject network transactions in real time.
Integrated the Atalla Payment HSM for PIN management, key-lifecycle operations, and PCI-DSS-compliant crypto — achieving 60% faster transaction processing versus a general-purpose HSM.

Implemented Two-Factor Authentication (MPIN + OTP) for financial transactions using Redis TTL-based OTP management, aligned with RBI and PCI-DSS expectations to strengthen fraud prevention and access control.

projects.title: Splitmoney
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Expense Splitting WebApp
projects.description: An event-driven expense-splitting platform with real-time debt resolution. Card/UPI payments settle debts via Hyperswitch with webhook-driven async processing, idempotent balance updates, and event-sourced reconciliation across microservices.
